escenas: Old-fashioned Mexican living room with dark wood furniture, afternoon light. Characters: LAWYER (60s, grey suit, round glasses), RAÚL (45, thick mustache, black suit), LUPE (40, black dress, sunglasses on her head), DANIEL (35, round glasses, grey tie), DOÑA CARMEN (60s, grey braid, white apron). The lawyer reads a will aloud to Raúl, Lupe and Daniel sitting on a sofa; they lean forward eagerly. Doña Carmen stands quietly in the background. Lawyer says: "Y la casa completa se la dejo a…"

Raúl interrupts confidently, Lupe glares at him. Raúl says: "Pues a mí, obviamente. Soy el mayor."

Old-fashioned Mexican living room with dark wood furniture, afternoon light. The lawyer raises his hand for silence and continues reading. All turn toward Doña Carmen. Lawyer says: "…a la señora que me cuidó estos años: Doña Carmen."

Doña Carmen opens the envelope and reads with a trembling voice while the siblings watch. Doña Carmen says: "«Perdónenme por callar la verdad durante cuarenta años…»"

Old-fashioned Mexican living room with dark wood furniture, afternoon light. Doña Carmen slowly unties her apron, folds the letter and faces the siblings. Doña Carmen says: "Su madre no murió en el parto. Su madre soy yo."

Old-fashioned Mexican living room with dark wood furniture, afternoon light. Characters: LAWYER (60s, grey suit, round glasses), RAÚL (45, thick mustache, black suit), LUPE (40, black dress, sunglasses on her head), DANIEL (35, round glasses, grey tie), DOÑA CARMEN (60s, grey braid, white apron). Stunned silence. Lupe's sunglasses fall. Daniel stands and slowly walks to hug Doña Carmen while Raúl sinks back onto the sofa. Daniel says: "Siempre lo sentí… mamá."
